tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch any team.management page as markdown by its path, e.g. /docs/daic or /protocols/task. Use search_docs first to find paths.

path.description: Site-relative page path starting with /, e.g. /docs/install

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the team.management documentation, protocols, and comparisons. Returns the most relevant sections with links.

query.description: Natural-language search query, e.g. 'how does DAIC enforcement work'
